name: Fly + Sky High
source:
Adi is an ex-pilot of the Dutch army. During the Japanese occupation, he returned to his home land. However, when he was looking to have a happy life with his wife, Rahayu, he was recruited to join the TKR-JP liberation forces.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210173629/http://neetministudio.blogspot.com/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
阿迪曾是荷兰军队的飞行员。日本占领期间，他回到了故乡。然而，正当他想和妻子拉哈尤过上幸福生活时，却被征召加入TKR-JP解放军。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210173629/http://neetministudio.blogspot.com/]官方网站[/url]]
